4452-6798-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

985-5078-5434-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3897-4677.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-4677.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-5708-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

225-851-3129-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1368-3499-3755-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3499-3755-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

713-2921--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

3259-5768-7296.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5768-7296.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

338-3129-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-3129-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

323-4050-5170-6132.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2341-2495-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type.
2341-2495-7013.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting White Lotus Tile and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting White Lotus Tile and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping White Lotus Tile and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

11-3617-5864-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-3617-5864-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Time Walk.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Time Walk spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Time Walk spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Time Walk and returning the original Time Walk to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Time Walk from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1395-5078-5864-6055.notablePrerequisites: Poison Dart Frog does not have summoning sickness.
1395-5078-5864-6055.description:
Activate Poison Dart Frog's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha of the Infinite's prowess ability and Valley Floodcaller trigger.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the Elsha of the Infinite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

437-509-2751-3263-4131.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-2751-3263-4131.description:
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 5.

578-1283-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
578-1283-4222.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least one artifact card from your hand, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

1091-4285-5005.notablePrerequisites:
At least 1 instant or sorcery in hand with mana available to cast it.
{3}{R}{R} also available.
1091-4285-5005.description:
Cast the spell in your hand.
In response cast Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to copy it.
Sevinne, the Chronoclasm's ability triggers copying Increasing Vengeance.
Copy the original Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat.
For each copy made Ral, Storm Conduit will trigger dealing 1 damage to an opponent.

1365-1495-4853.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Triskelion and any number of other target creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Triskelion until there is only one +1/+1 counter remaining on it, dealing 1 damage to any target for each activation.
Activate Triskelion again by removing the last +1/+1 counter from it.
Triskelion dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its own persist ability and Dross Scorpion.
Resolve Dross Scorpion's ability, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve Triskelion's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with three +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
The -1/-1 counter and one +1/+1 counter are removed from Triskelion as a state-based action.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
